with_dax.speaker: dax
with_dax.text: That's it. Pressure's at forty percent. There's a Weft charge in the coupling; someone routed magic through the seal to keep it alive. I can't touch it. You can.

choices.text: Reset it. The Weft keeps your people breathing, Dax.
Rip the Weft charge out and route it clean.

reset.speaker: dax
reset.text: Holding. Forty people, breathing on witch-light. I'll learn to live with it. That's what you do.

clean.speaker: dax
clean.text: Holding, and no Weft in the line. I owe you a reason. Later. When it's earned.

alone.speaker: player
alone.text: A pressure console, still routed to a vault. Forty souls on the readout and a Weft charge keeping the seal alive. Somebody's family.

dead.speaker: player
dead.text: Dax never made it here. The readout says forty. It does not say whose.
